subject: Literature
title: The Henriad and the Education of a King
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Henriad and the Education of a King.

hook.text: Shakespeare wrote four connected plays tracking a prince from tavern drunk to legendary king of England.

buildup.text: In Henry IV Parts 1 and 2, Prince Hal drinks and jokes with Falstaff while his father's kingdom crumbles.

discovery.text: Falstaff is one of Shakespeare's greatest creations: a fat, lying, cowardly knight who is irresistibly lovable.

twist.text: When Hal becomes king, he publicly rejects Falstaff, breaking the audience's heart along with the old man's.

climax.text: The Henriad asks whether becoming a great leader requires destroying the person you used to be.

punchline.text: The king was born when the friend was abandoned.

quiz.question: What happens to Falstaff when Prince Hal becomes king?
options: He becomes the king's chief advisor
He leads the army into France
